# Frozen results (W3.5)

Written by `scripts/40_freeze.py` on 2026-10-17T11:29:12Z at commit `b57f233e4971101461f1832193427933b0ad7a73` with uncommitted changes. Nothing under this folder is edited
by hand. `python scripts/40_freeze.py --check --sweep configs/sweeps/<name>.yaml` recomputes every hash below
and regenerates the tables of `reports/tables/<name>/` from `runs/`, which must match byte for byte on the
machine that wrote them (floats carry 12 significant digits; another BLAS kernel can move a last digit).

## Folders

- `runs/`: one folder per run of the ladder, the pilot and the full sweep: manifest.json, results.csv, transcriptions/, references/, coherence.csv, determinism.csv and progress.log (section 2.8); the rendered pages under images/ are git-ignored and not copied.
- `equivariance/`: the shift-equivariance error per layer of each vision tower, <reader>_<text_type>.csv and manifest.json (W1.9, Figure 0).
- `mtf/`: the layer-0 modulation transfer per reader (section 3S.1).
